subject.title: [Feature]: Add TTL/Expiry for Delivery Queue Messages

question: What outbound delivery expiry policy should OpenClaw expose for queued recovery: which config key, default behavior, and expired-entry action?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public config and changes whether existing queued messages replay after upgrade.

options.title: Opt-in messages.delivery TTL
options.body: Add optional messages.delivery.maxAgeMs with a closed failed/quarantine-style expired action, preserving current no-TTL default while covering startup and reconnect drains.

options.title: Finite default TTL
options.body: Ship a default max age to prevent stale floods without user setup, accepting a compatibility-sensitive behavior change for existing recovery queues.

options.title: Broader freshness design
options.body: Pause the outbound-only fix and design outbound plus inbound message freshness together, reducing policy drift but delaying the known outbound repair.

recommendation.title: Opt-in messages.delivery TTL
recommendation.body: Add optional messages.delivery.maxAgeMs with a closed failed/quarantine-style expired action, preserving current no-TTL default while covering startup and reconnect drains.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent delivery-queue/config history and already supplied concrete maintainer-facing direction on this issue.
